archetypes.label: Intuitive
archetypes.tagline: You decide the way you taste food — first impression, then go.
archetypes.blind-spot: Gut reads can miss the thing that only shows up after a second look.

archetypes.label: Analytical
archetypes.tagline: You decide the way you build a model — gather, weight, then commit.
archetypes.blind-spot: A perfect model can crowd out the call that needed to be made yesterday.

archetypes.label: Collaborative
archetypes.tagline: You decide with the room — not by committee, but by listening.
archetypes.blind-spot: Listening widely can stall when the call has to land with one person.

archetypes.label: Spontaneous
archetypes.tagline: You decide fast and learn fast — the rest is just details.
archetypes.blind-spot: Decisions made in motion can land in places you didn't quite intend.

archetypes.label: Deliberative
archetypes.tagline: You decide carefully — gather, check, then commit and own it.
archetypes.blind-spot: Care can shade into over-checking the decisions that didn't need it.
